source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll Chinese landscape with layered pale-green mountains, ink-line rock texture, pine and deciduous groves, scattered pavilions and village compounds, winding paths with small figures, and a foreground stream valley. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_crag_peak_with_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain mass rising near the top: pale green and ochre peak, angular ink contour lines, vertical clefts, scattered dark texture dots, and small pine groves clinging to ledges on the upper and middle slopes.
must_preserve: thin angular ink linework defining crags and fissures
pale green mineral wash with warm ochre cap near the summit
dark dotted texture strokes along ridges
compact pine clusters with individual needle-dot foliage
soft fading edges where the peak dissolves into mist

motifs.name: misty_side_mountain_layers
motifs.description: Isolate the subdued background mountain silhouettes and atmospheric washes flanking the central peak, including the soft left ridges and the faint right triangular peak behind the valley.
must_preserve: very pale grey-green washes
soft blurred ridge contours
layered atmospheric recession
empty mist gaps between mountain forms
minimal faint ink outlines without hard foreground detail

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion compound perched on the upper-right cliff, together with the immediate rocky ledge and surrounding tree screen.
must_preserve: small rectilinear building with tiled roof geometry
thin railing and wall lines
dense dark tree-dot foliage behind and beside the pavilion
pale cliff planes with broken ink cracks
ledge-like placement above the valley

motifs.name: mid_slope_temple_and_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left/central hillside temple cluster: several small roofed halls nestled among pines and mixed trees on stepped rocky slopes.
must_preserve: curved tiled roofs with parallel roof-line strokes
white wall planes and delicate doorway outlines
dense vertical pine trunks and dotted needle foliage
mixed shrub textures around buildings
rock terraces and slanting ink fissures supporting the structures

motifs.name: winding_path_with_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow mountain path traversing the mid-right slope, with tiny walking scholar figures and attendants, plus the adjacent grove framing the path.
must_preserve: thin winding path contour along the cliff face
small robed figures rendered with minimal ink strokes
tiny walking gestures and spacing between figures
dark clustered tree crowns along the right side
rock striations dropping below the path

motifs.name: right_village_courtyard_complex
motifs.description: Isolate the larger architectural village complex on the right middle slope: multi-roofed halls, courtyards, walls, small gathered figures, and nearby trees.
must_preserve: layered tiled roofs with ridgelines and eave curves
arched doorways and white plaster wall shapes
courtyard walls and terrace outlines
small human figures in robes within the courtyards and lane
surrounding dark foliage masses and pale rock base

motifs.name: foreground_riverside_lodge_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left riverside lodge and its enclosing grove: long waterside building on a stone foundation, smaller roof behind, tall pines and broadleaf trees climbing the slope.
must_preserve: long low tiled roof and open veranda with tiny seated figures
stone-block retaining wall beneath the lodge
overlapping tree trunks with ochre-brown accents
pine needle clusters and stippled broadleaf canopies
rocky slope lines wrapping around the grove

motifs.name: foreground_stream_waterfall_valley
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central stream valley with the falling water, rippled pool, small crossing/boat-like element, flanking rocks, and the large leaning tree on the right bank.
must_preserve: thin vertical waterfall strokes descending between rocks
horizontal ripple lines in the pool
small dark human/boat-like marks near the water edge
large right-bank tree with pale stippled canopy and darker crown patches
angular foreground rock faces with fine ink cracks and pale washes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
